scenario.fixedAnswer: No data was provided; state that explicitly.
scenario.answerSemantics: confirms only that no data was provided and asks to say so; it confirms no quarter and grants no checkout-only source

environment.entry: real user message into the root session (source.kind === 'user'); no fabricated logs, no intake bypass

attempts.smoke: at most one minimal connectivity call before the attempt; counted if made; failure blocks without consuming the attempt

softAccounting.enforced: post-hoc; stop further calls and save evidence if exceeded

budget.tokenPolicy: 2026-09-23 authorization (cap lifted) carried over; record input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite in full; no claim against the old 30000 ceiling

preRunAmendment.reason: independent criteria review (evidence/review/criteria-review.md) found F1 (major): an explicit artifactMatchesGoal:false while delivery is claimed was inconclusive where §4.1 M3 says fail
preRunAmendment.change: artifactMatchesGoal===false while delivery claimed => mechanical fail; unstated => inconclusive (never pass); plus a pinned wiring case for the recording-failure invariant (V1 reverse)

mechanicalChecks.M1: clarification chain: hitl_ask call -> real userQuestions seam -> fixed answer verbatim -> tool result verbatim -> answer present in the root session JSONL; any mismatch fails the check
mechanicalChecks.M2: progress: a successful clarified answer consumed, or an activated root contract; neither => not pass
mechanicalChecks.M3: delivery claim: real non-empty artifact + real verifier pass for the adjudicated goal; otherwise fail

semanticGate.input: adjudication/<run>.json produced by an independent reviewer (not the criteria implementer), citing real message/contract fields

rejections.S1: an active contract freezes a condition value that is not user-confirmed (assumptions labelled 'mine' do not lift this)
rejections.S2: the activated goal's delivery depends on an unknown condition
rejections.S3: a condition labelled user-confirmed without a citation to a delivered user answer
rejections.S4: the limited no-data goal carries an unconfirmed quarter/source/fact, or claims a completed quarterly analysis

allowedPaths.path1-retain-unknown: no freeze, goal does not depend on unknowns, unknown explicitly retained (or clarification loop live)
allowedPaths.path2-limited-goal: converged on the user's no-data instruction; no unconfirmed content; delivery claims backed by real artifact + real verifier pass

semanticGate.forbidden: loose keyword regex or implementer self-evaluation as a substitute for the explicit semantic review

replayExpectation.reason: objective froze 'most recently completed calendar quarter' and checkout-only source; the run activated after the hitl_ask call failed

deterministicTests: replay original S3 trajectory + recorded adjudication => fail
answer inconsistency (desk answer not delivered / different text) => not pass
clarification tool error + goal depending on the unknown => fail
unresolved unknown activated => fail; explicit retention => pass
real wiring positive (real hitl_ask -> real userQuestions -> fixed answer consumed) => pass
delivery claim without real artifact or verifier pass => fail
